findings.note: Per-action phase guard enforces peer stability (peers_stable must equal flowing count); cited phasing guarantee (halt while dark) holds. 30s/120s asymmetry is design, not a demonstrated defect.

findings.claim: With two eligible failing cameras and a healthy witness, observe mode evaluates both candidates and records would_recover for each in the same poll. Recover mode instead proposes only the first and waits for its outcome;
findings.note: would_recover per candidate is documented intended observe-mode semantics (policy.py:792-808: hypothetical decisions, recover reboots one at a time). No defect.

findings.claim: The first flowing sample ends the reported outage and clears outage_rebooted, even before recovery is confirmed. If frames stop again during boot grace or a latch, the early returns suppress a new frames_stopped event; w
findings.note: Clear-on-first-return (policy.py:536-537) and restart-on-dark (634) verified; whether frames_stopped is actually omitted depends on untraced confirmation gating during latch/boot-grace.

findings.claim: The pair validator accepts any supported delivery mode for either profile, so a retail/private and B2B/public_consumer pair can receive a pair-check PASS. The M0 contract requires retail/public_consumer and B2B/private.

Claims are keyed by case, so concurrent authenticated requests for the stored and Deflate cases can both acquire their claims and extract simultaneously. This does not enforce the documented single concurrent extraction
